question: What are Netflix's (NASDAQ: NFLX) Total Projected Material Cash Requirements for 2025?
model_answer:
Netflix's projected material cash requirements for 2025 total about **$14.43 billion** ($14,426,266 thousand). This is the "Next 12 Months" column in the contractual obligations table of its FY2024 10-K, which covers the period from December 31, 2024.

| Obligation | Next 12 months (2025) | Total | Beyond 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Content obligations | $11,424,696K | $23,248,931K | $11,824,235K |
| Debt (principal and interest) | $2,486,945K | $19,841,462K | $17,354,517K |
| Operating lease obligations | $514,625K | $2,761,120K | $2,246,495K |
| **Total** | **$14,426,266K** | **$45,851,513K** | **$31,425,247K** |

Netflix says its material cash requirements from known contractual and other obligations primarily relate to its content, debt and lease obligations. The total across all periods is about $45.85 billion.

The FY2025 10-K, filed in 2026, has a similar table, but its "Next 12 Months" figure covers 2026 and totals about $13.78 billion.

Source: [Netflix FY2024 Form 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1065280/000106528025000044/nflx-20241231.htm)
